segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move that we consider the proposed budget of the Philippine Competition Commission.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Is there any objection? The Chair hears none. The motion is approved. Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rhea Mae A. Gullas
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, may we acknowledge the heads and the officials of the Philippine Competition Commission,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rhea Mae A. Gullas
segments.text: Chairperson Michael Aguinaldo, Commissioner Mara Victoria Querol, Commissioner Michael Peloton, Commissioner Lolibeth Medrano, Commissioner Ferdinand Negre. I so move, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: To the heads of the Philippine Competition Commission headed by the Chairperson, the Honorable Michael G. Aguinaldo, welcome to the House of Representatives. Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rhea Mae A. Gullas
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move that we open the period of sponsorship and debate.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Is there any objection? The Chair hears none. The motion is approved. Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rhea Mae A. Gullas
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move that we recognize the Honorable Dante Garcia, Vice Chair of the Committee on Appropriations, to sponsor the budget of the Philippine Competition Commission.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: The Honorable Dante Garcia is recognized. Please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rhea Mae A. Gullas
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move that we recognize the honorable...

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, to my esteemed colleague in the House of Representatives,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: I once again stand to sponsor the budget of an agency that is vital to the strength of our economy across various sectors,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: The Philippine Competition Commission, the PCC, implements the Philippine Competition Act

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: abuse of dominant position, and anti-competitive mergers and acquisitions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: This would turn, ensure that business compete and consumers benefit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: Since we approved its budget in 2026, the PCC has ramped up its surveillance and investigative capabilities in procurement and bidding anomalies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: Scrutinize mergers and acquisitions that may harm markets.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: Cast light on questionable business practices through economic research and increase...

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: The business sector's understanding of competition law through advocacy and capacity-building activities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: In terms of its surveillance and investigative mandate,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: the PCC has answered the nation's clamor to look into anomalous flood control projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: The PCC has referred to the Department of Justice its initial findings involving...

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: bidrigging in flood control projects in Bulacan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: Further, the PCC together with the NBI conducted a dawn raid

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: covering premises associated with SunWest Incorporated,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: Eco Leisure and Hospitality Holdings Company, Inc.,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: where the PCC and NBI reasonably suspect that relevant documentary

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: and electronic records related to the ongoing investigation were located.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: This decisive action underscores PCC's commitment to ensuring that business

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: operate within the bounds of the Philippine Competition Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: In addition, the PCC has fined the Boracay Business Administration

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: of Scuba Shops and 40 of its member dive shops,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: 2.17 million for engaging in price-fixing on Boracay Island.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: Malay, Aklan, and directed BBASS and its member dive shops

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: to cease and desist from enforcing the multi-year price-fixing agreement

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: The PCC has likewise reviewed 21 mergers and acquisitions

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: with the transaction value that approximately

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: 515.6 billion pesos for any competition concerns

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: Across sectors such as energy and financial services,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: the PCC together with the DICT and NTC

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: likewise finalized the implementation of rules and regulations

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: which aims to foster competition among

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: Lastly, given the importance of awareness and competition laws

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: by the private sector and its regulators,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: the PCC continues to conduct advocacy and capacity-building activities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: The PCC secured pledges from four of the biggest business organizations

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: in the country, namely the Philippine Chamber of Commerce,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: The Philippine Retailers Association, the Pharmaceutical and Healthcare Association of the Philippines, and the Financial Executive Institute of the Philippines to uphold the provisions of the Philippine Competition Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: With a budget of P587.6 million, the PCC was able to achieve the aforementioned initiatives, as I believe that the PCC can do more with more resources to help the government protect public funds.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: While the overall national budget for 2027 sees a 6% increase, our specific request for the PCC is calibrated to address the complex challenges,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: This budget will enable us to significantly ramp up our surveillance and investigative capabilities,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: allowing us to proactively detect and dismantle cartels, anti-competitive conduct, and bidrigging schemes that prey on each Filipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: This budget will be used to bolster our enforcement arm,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: analytics capabilities to identify suspicious bidding patterns,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: and strengthen our collaboration with other oversight agencies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: We are here to assure this Chamber that the PCC is fully committed to protect the public purse from the predatory practices of anti-competitive behavior.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: I urge my colleagues to support this budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: As it is about for fair markets, for fiscal responsibility, and for more competitive, prosperous Philippines.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you, Honorable Garcia, Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rhea Mae A. Gullas
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move that we recognize the Honorable Presley De Jesus for his interpellation.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: The Honorable Presley De Jesus of Party-list PHILRECA is recognized.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, and to the distinguished sponsor, my idol.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: My question is about the competition in Philippine renewable energy sector.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished sponsor, good evening po sa atin lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: PCC plays a crucial role in ensuring healthy competition in the energy sector.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Is it true that the PCC had already conducted a competition impact assessment?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: of the Green Energy Auction Program, or GEAP, with the DOE and ERC?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: Yes, the PCC conducted the study in 2025 and then conducted policy dialogue with the DOE and ERC last January and March of this year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: The study examined whether specific features of the program may create or facilitate anti-competitive effects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: in the renewable energy sector, and identified policy options to address potential competition concerns,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: including the role of the PCC in coordination with the DOE, ERC, and other relevant bodies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, distinguished sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: My follow-up question is, is it also true that the group had identified competition concerns

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: involving the geographic segmentation of the green energy sector?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: the determination of Green Energy Auction Reserve, or GEAR, prices and the disclosure of price caps and conduct of pre-bid conferences, among others.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Can you share those competition concerns for the benefit of the body and the sector as a whole?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: The PCC's role is to primarily assess the competition effects of GEAP

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: within the existing framework and recommend pro-competitive reforms to the agencies concerned,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: The study identified three potential competition concerns.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: First, the location-specific or per-grid auction design.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: Second is the consistency and transparency of GEAR price determination

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: and the disclosure of auction-related information, particularly GEAR prices,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: My next follow-up question, Mr. Speaker,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: My question to the good sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: into the conduct of oil companies

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: When stations price increase rapidly with international prices but adjust slowly when this cost decrease, it also aims to look at price dispersion within a city and determine whether particular stations or brands show delayed rollback or remain persistently above local market prices.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: The study is ongoing pending data requests with fuel players and government agencies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: PCC has started gathering and analyzing industry data to determine whether firm behavior during this time reflect a competitive environment or not.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: Specifically looking at how firms adjust prices with and without the supply shocks.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: PCC issued requests for information to key players in the industry, some of which have complied with the request.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: At present, the PCC is analyzing the industry data.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: The PCC is analyzing the data to determine whether the behavior of the key players indicate possible anti-competitive conduct.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: The PCC has received request data from the DOA today, September 18, 2026.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Good Sponsor, a few days ago, I have raised urgent concerns related to privacy risks in digital platforms.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Incidentally, I came across the information that PCC's market study on social media and search platform found that the Philippines' digital platform market is highly concentrated and identified the accumulation of user data as a potential source of market power.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: It specifically discussed Facebook and Google and observed that data advantages,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: network effects, and economies of scale may reinforce barriers to entry.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: What does the PCC intend to do with these findings beyond publishing the market study?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: The PCC has recommended incorporating data privacy considerations more explicitly into competition assessments.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: Strengthening coordination with privacy regulators and considering legislative measures to update the competition framework for data-driven markets.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: In 2024, the PCC received substantial resources for the capacity building to foster competition projects,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: appropriation for the foreign-assisted project was obligated.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: We note that said amount is part of the continuing appropriation for the project released in 2023.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: At that time, PCC requested for the issuance of SARO amounting 104 million only.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: Equivalent to the loan proceeds downloaded by ADB, however,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: Which resulted to the excess resources.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: ADB's project data showed that as of June 23, 2026,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: cumulative contract awards were only 45% and cumulative loan disbursements were 41%

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: and the loan has now been extended to June 30, 2028.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Those figures are not identical to COA's

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: but they still indicate that the substantial portion of the project financing remained undisbursed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: can the PCC give us its quarterly obligation and disbursement target for fiscal year 2027

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: and identify exactly what activities will absorb these funds.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: The PCC can point to the loan extension, revised procurement, programming, additional project proposals, and strengthened monitoring as measures intended to accelerate implementation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker. And for my last question, how many pending antitrust or pending cases have been filed or are being reviewed by the Philippine Competition Commission?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: There are seven active cases ongoing, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Can we divulge what those seven are, or will it be against the PCC's confidentiality clause?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: We will submit the complete data to you, Your Honor, for you to review.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Okay. Thank you. Because, Mr. Speaker, distinguished sponsor, you know the Philippine Competition Commission plays a big role, especially to those merging companies, no, para hindi ho tayo maiwanan sa ere at walang collusion, especially po pagdating sa fuel. As you know, malaki ang problema natin sa fuel ngayon, and I hope the PCC will take cognizance when it comes to energy sources. Again,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Speaker, and I always [unclear] for your budget for PCC for this year. Thank you very much.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you, Honorable De Jesus, Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rhea Mae A. Gullas
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move that we recognize the Honorable Robert Nazal for his interpellation.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: The Honorable Robert Nazal of Partylist BH is recognized. Please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Colleague, may I ask the PCC, have you studied what happens when a major retailer is both the gatekeeper of the market and a competitor of suppliers selling inside its stores?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Major retailers carry products made by independent suppliers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: But they may also develop their own private label products.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Sometimes products very similar to those already being successfully sold by their suppliers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So there is nothing inherently illegal about private labels.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: But the retailer knows what sells, controls the shelf, and counter space, controls inventory and promotions,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: and then competes against the supplier with its own product.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: At what point does this become a competition concern?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Inaanalyze po ba natin when it becomes predatory in practice?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: The PCC is closely monitoring that's happening and a thorough investigation will be conducted.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Meron na po ba kayong nakitang mga ganito? And were there complaints, for example, that were filed with the PCC that was actually investigated upon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And what intervention, Mr. Chair and distinguished colleague, ang ginawa po ng PCC?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: There were minor complaints but it was given an attention and it was informed to the manufacturer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, meron po ba tayong portal na pwedeng magreklamo ang, let's say, SMEs?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: Of the PCC and the social media.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And is it very easy to file a complaint? And once an SME, for example, files a complaint against any predatory practice, ganong katagal ang response time?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: Yes, pwedeng madali ang mag-file ng complaint kasi pwede sa online at sa Facebook page ng PCC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: Kaya ganon, kadali ang pag-file, may investigation kagad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Mr. Chair, distinguished colleague, let me give a practical example.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Kung may independent brand na successful, then the retailer comes out with a very similar own brand product at a lower price.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Tapos yung sariling brand niya, prominently displayed and readily available sa counter.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: While yung competing product, wala doon, kailangan magbayad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Tapos yung staff, kailangan pang umalas para kunin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: The retailer controls both the competition and the playing field.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Does the PCC examine practices like this?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And ano pong actions ang pwede natin gawin in case meron tayong nahuhuling ganito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: What intervention can the PCC do in behalf of those experiencing predatory practices?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: The PCC can file a case against the retailer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: What if the retailer po is a giant?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And pwede po niyang balikan kasi yung halimbawa, pwede niyang balikan yung SME.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And if there are only a few retailers in the country, paano po ang mangyayari kung ang gagawin niya,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: ang magiging balik niya doon sa nagreklamo, ay ibabanan niya sa shelf?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: The PCC is mandated. May mandato ang PCC na kahit malaking tao man lang, kahit gaano kalaki, pwedeng sagasaan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: The PCC guarantees that it can protect small players against practices such as this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Thank you for that, Mr. Chair, distinguished sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Mr. Chair, has PCC ever conducted a market study comparing how major retailers treat their own private label products versus competing independent brands?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: In shelf and counter placement, inventory availability,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Because ang concern po natin is not simply that they copied the product or made something cheaper.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: The concern is whether a powerful retailer can identify a successful product from one of its suppliers,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: and then use its control of the retail channel to give its own product.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: An unfair advantage, and eventually squeeze the independent supplier out.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Does our present competition framework adequately protect against that?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: Wala pang public study, but we had compelled a very big retailer to be fair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Is there anything you need, for example, from Congress in terms of amending your charter, strengthening it?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Meron po ba tayo naiisip na mga pwede natin baguhin para po palakasin at bigyan ng pangil ang Philippine Competition Commission

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: para po lalo natin maprotektahan ang ating mga maliliit na nag-uumpisang maghanap buhay?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: There is a pending bill on the committee.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: And the PCC is closely working with the committee.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: I would like to co-author that, Mr. Chair, and the distinguished sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Mr. Chair, is PCC looking at the same gatekeeper problem in online platforms

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: where the operator of the marketplace may also sell or promote products that compete with merchants

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: What safeguards does PCC consider necessary when the platform or retailer controls both

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: access to customer and the competitive environment?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Para sa online naman po ito, distinguished sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: Yes, we are looking to it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: And in terms of safeguarding the…

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: We are closely monitoring the market, and if there is a violation, we are bound to file a complaint.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Kaya ako po tinatanong ito, Distinguished Sponsor, Mr. Speaker. Kasi po, ang napansin ko, noon, lalo na nung pandemic, naging advantage po ngayon yung online retailers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So yung online platforms were helping yung ating maliliit na negosyante. Parang ang lumalabas ngayon, yung ating mga retailers, giant retailers,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: tsaka yung online at digital platforms are already charging, if not the same, yung ating digital platforms are charging even more.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And ang gusto ko po sanang alamin is kung natitignan po natin yung charges na sinisingil nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Kasi if you will ask and do conduct a study or maybe an online survey, tanungin nyo po yung mga nagbibenta online.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: The digital platforms are now charging maybe up to 60%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And parang ang nangyayari, kung 100 pesos yung binibenta mo, 60 pesos na yung kinukuha nila, minsan 70 pesos pa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So ang matitira sa'yo, 30 pesos, kukunin mo pa dun yung cost mo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So my concern is the PCC looking into that. Kasi po, dapat ho, I think it's about time that we monitor this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Kasi kung ano-anong charges ang nilalagay nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia
segments.text: We have looked into the digital platforms but not into that specific issue but we will see it now.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Thank you for that, Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Mr. Chair, Distinguished Sponsor, have you also studied the competition implications when a conglomerate owns both a bank and businesses in sectors heavily dependent on financing such as real estate?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Even if related party lending complies with banking regulations, can preferential access to financing reinforce market power in the conglomerate's non-banking business?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And has PCC studied this as a structural competition issue?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Ang tinatanong ko po ay yung possible whether PCC studies cross-sector competitive effects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So you're already looking into that, Mr. Chair?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So meron na po ba kayong nakita na, for example, industry na because of this, nagkakaroon ng unfair advantage?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And if this is so, what is the, ano po ang gagawin ng PCC in order to help level the playing field?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dante S. Garcia

segments.text: Mr. Chair, Mr. Chair, Distinguished Colleague, the PCC's proposed 2027 budget is approximately 832 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor, good evening.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Earlier this year, DBM issued Corporate Budget Memorandum No. 48 for the Fiscal Year 2027 Corporate Budget Call.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Under the policy, it was stated that the DBM should not be involved in corporate budget calls.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Under the policy, it was stated that a GOCC receiving 60% or more its funding from national government subsidies for the past 10 consecutive years is automatically flagged for mandatory institutional review for GOCCs covered by Republic Act No. 10149.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: That review is to be conducted by GCG. Is this correct, Mr. Speaker, Madam Sponsor?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And my follow-up question, then under those parameters, how many GOCCs under GCG's jurisdiction currently meet the 60% subsidy for 10 years threshold?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: The study is ongoing regarding the number, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: The GCG is just checking their records, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: The GCG will just submit the list of GOCCs that satisfy their requirement, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: That's okay with my distinguished colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: have institutional reviews which are now mandated already commenced?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: For every one of those GOCCs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: If not, what the timetables are we looking at?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Regarding the monitoring and evaluation of GOCCs, Mr. Speaker, the GCG currently conducts three.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: There's the performance evaluation system for GOCCs, and then there's the performance evaluation for directors in the GOCC sector.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: And then the GCG also produces corporate governance scorecards.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: But as per the finalization of the reports for fiscal year 2020,

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: the GCG is dependent on the submission of COA financial statement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: So as of now, review is still currently ongoing, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So do we expect that later this year or it's going to be next year?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Yes, later in this year, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: How many directors are, as you mentioned, that under review?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: For, Mr. Speaker, for clarification, director, total directors for all the GOCCs that are being reviewed, total.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: We're pulling up the actual number.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: So estimated around, approximately around 500 directors, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor, could the good sponsor provide the following information for the consideration of this body?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: The amount of national government support received by these GOCCs during the past 10 years, its performance, scorecard results,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: and the current status of GCG's institutional review.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: It's important because the new DBM policy says they are now subject to mandatory institutional review to be conducted by GCG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Kasi po, meron na pong DBM policy na bago ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Speaker, just to clarify, the first would be the amount of government support received by the GOCCs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: What's the second one, Mr. Speaker?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: No, that's the question because I'm just interjecting that there's a new DBM policy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Now, they have to be subjected for mandatory institutional review to be conducted by GCG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, the GCG is just pulling up the actual number.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: However, just an overall observation regarding the amount of government support,

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: it's been declining given that those GOCCs that previously needed government support are now improving in performance.

segments.text: yung mga manggagawa nito ay hindi nakapagtimpe,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: That is, yun yung gusto natin, hanggat maaari,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: ayaw natin tumuntong sa isang sitwasyon na hindi natin makukontrol

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: dahil very personal at malalim ang hugot ng mga manggagawa sa GFIs

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: dito sa mga nawalang allowances, benefits, and incentives.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: And for so long, hindi nila nakukuha yung sagot from GCG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: And it is a welcome development that the sponsor is assuring this representation

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: that through the chairperson of GCG ay magkakaroon tayo ng pag-uusap.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Now, on to the third question, part of my question.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Malinaw po na nakasaad sa saligang batas natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: and in fact, this has been enshrined in labor laws and other relevant labor laws,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: yung karapatan ng mga manggagawa na organisahin yung kanyang sarili

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: at makipag-negosasyon o makipagtawaran sa kanyang employer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Kung sa pampublikong sektor, collective negotiation ang tawag.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So sa pribadong sektor, collective bargaining.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: In fact, sa Article 13, Section 3, at maging sa Executive Order No. 180,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: garantisado ang karapatan ng lahat ng manggagawa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: kasama ang mga manggagawa sa pampublikong sektor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: pagdating sa usapin ng self-organization and collective negotiation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Pero ito po yung malaking katanungan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Yung mga GOCC boards na magkaroon ng collective negotiation with its workers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So there is an absolute blanket prohibition.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So papaano po, so does the Commission honestly believe that

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: this absolute blanket prohibition on negotiating every single economic,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: so yung economic provisions po ang pinatutungkulan Madam Sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: so negotiating every single economic term,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: is consistent with the constitutional guarantee of self-organization?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, as for the GCG, there is recognition of their right to self-organization. However, in terms of bargaining for economic terms, apparently there are already a long list of Supreme Court rulings that...

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: What is that specific Supreme Court ruling?

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: I'd like to reiterate. Constitutional guarantee, yung collective negotiation. So ano po yung sa Supreme Court ruling?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: If I'm allowed to enumerate, this is for your GSIS Family Bank Employees Union v. Villanueva, JR number 210773.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: 210773, a rule that may not negotiate with their officers and employees the economic terms of their collective bargaining agreements.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: And then for another Supreme Court ruling, PNCC versus NLRC, G.R. number 24...

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Yeah, PNCC versus NLRC, G.R. number 248401, said that with the subsequent enactment of RA 10149,

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: PNCC may no longer grant this benefit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Without persecuring the requisite authority of the President.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Without the authority of the President.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Hayaan niyo po, Madam Sponsor, na reviewin din ang kinatawang ito, yung binanggit niyo po na jurisprudence on this matter.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Kaya po maganda nga na magkakaroon tayo ng dialogo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So as to reconcile our reading on this particular case.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Kasi napakalinaw na tila baga nadidefeat na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ang constitutional guarantee pagdating sa collective negotiation, medyo mabigat po yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Nadagok sa mga union ng mga manggagawa dahil the reason of existence po ng mga union ng mga manggagawa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: may it be in private or public sector, ay para may abante yung mga panawagan tungkol sa pagdadagdag ng sahod,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Yun nga po, yung abis na tinatawag.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So marami pong katanungan pa na gustong himayin ang kinatawang ito, pero dahil limitado po ang oras natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: will we get that commitment again from the distinguished sponsor and the GCG through its chairperson,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: for us to sit down together and have an honest to goodness talk and dialogue about this matter and questions of workers in the GFIs?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Yes, we reaffirm the commitment and I was also informed by our good chairperson that this coming Friday, next Friday,

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: may meeting daw po with the labor groups firm, GFIs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Sponsor and through the chairperson of GCG for affirming.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: That commitment, dahil ako rin po ang kinatawang ito ay nais malinawan sa napakaraming mga tanong.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So thank you, Madam Sponsor, to my good friend and asahan ko po yung pagtutulungan natin on this matter.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: And with that, Mr. Speaker, Madam Sponsor, there being no other member from the minority to interpolate for the budget of GCG,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: To terminate the period of sponsorship and debate for the plenary consideration of the budget of the Governance Commission for GOCCs for Fiscal Year 2027.

segments.text: To consider the proposed budget of the Mindanao Development Authority.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Is there any objection? The Chair hears none. Motion is approved. Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rhea Mae A. Gullas
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, may we acknowledge the heads and officials of the Mindanao Development Authority, Chairperson Leo Magno, Usec Janet Lopoz, Asec Romeo Montenegro. I so move, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: To the family of the Mindanao Development Authority, headed by the Chairperson, Secretary Leo Tereso Magno, welcome to the House of Representatives. Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rhea Mae A. Gullas
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move that you recognize the Honorable Nicanor Briones, Vice Chairperson of the Committee on Appropriations to sponsor the proposed budget of the Mindanao Development Authority.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: The Honorable Representative Niki Briones is recognized. Please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Dear colleagues, ladies and gentlemen, good evening.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: I rise today to sponsor the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget of the Mindanao Development Authority, headed by Secretary Leo Tereso Magno.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: By virtue of Republic Act No. 9996, to promote, coordinate, and facilitate the socio-economic development of Mindanao through an integrated approach promoting trade, tourism, investment, private enterprises, and peace.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: It also serves as the permanent Philippine Coordinating Office for the Brunei Darussalam-Indonesia-Malaysia-Philippines East ASEAN Growth Area.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: It acts as the Secretariat for the Mindanao Power Monitoring Committee, Mindanao River Basin Management Council, NTF-ELCAC, and Cabinet Officer for Regional Development and Security in Mindanao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: It also implements critical strategic programs for the Mindanao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Such as the Project RIBER, which helps local government units develop, rehabilitate, and maintain its water supply infrastructure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: These programs are aligned with the Mindanao Agenda, which aims to achieve inclusive economic recovery, sustain green growth, build resilience, and strengthen peace and development for an improved quality of life for every Mindanao citizen.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: [unclear] by 2030. For this, we respectfully seek this Chamber's support to consider and approve the proposed budget of the Mindanao Development Authority for fiscal year 2027, amounting to ₱272,435,000. Together, let us help a better Mindanao. Thank you very much, and I now welcome any questions from our colleagues.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you, Honorable Briones. Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rhea Mae A. Gullas
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move that we recognize the Honorable Presley De Jesus for his interpellation.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Ferjenel G. Biron, M.D.
segments.text: The Honorable Presley De Jesus of Party-list PHILRECA is recognized. Please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker. Of course, to the distinguished sponsor, this is about the Mindanao Energy Security.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Question. Mr. Speaker, this is the sponsor. Based on the projects, Minda has identified reliable and affordable electricity necessary for their success and sustainability.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Okay, let me repeat my question. Based on the projects, MinDA has identified reliable and affordable electricity necessary for their success and sustainability. In short, naka-rely po kayo sa success ng the Mindanao project, yung affordable electricity for their success and sustainability. Yes or no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker. Does Minda recognize electricity as a foundational requirement for Mindanao's industrial, agricultural, commercial, educational, health, and social development?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Can MinDA describe what they know about the Agus-Pulangi hydropower complex?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Sir, can you describe what they know?

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: We support all our efforts for the rehabilitation of the Agus Pulangi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, are you familiar with the Agus-Pulangi hydropower complex?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Alam niyo po, ang Agus-Pulangi, yan po yung matagal na pong pinagkukunan, source of energy sa Mindanao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: That's why Congressman Sergio Dagooc, passionate siya pagdating po rito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, ang tanong ko po, because as we know, marami.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Marami po nag-aahangad sa Agus-Pulangi na ma-privatize.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, do the Mindanao officers ng Mindanao Development Authority, are you in favor of, on record, are you in favor of privatizing Agus-Pulangi?

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: What the Mindanao Development Authority wants is rehabilitation, not privatization.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, in short, you're in favor or you're not in favor of privatizing Agus-Pulangi?

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: No, no. Mindanao is not in favor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Second, so, as we know, that Agus-Pulangi hydropower needs rehabilitation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: As of now, the capacity of the Agus-Pulangi hydropower plant is 1,000 megawatts and it's only running 600 to 700 megawatts, distinguished colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, in short, again, let me do some fun facts.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: The National Power Corporation identifies the Agus-Pulangi complexes as having a combined installed capacity of 982 megawatts

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: and supplying more than 50% of Mindanao's electricity requirements.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Alam po natin kung ano po ang kalagayan ng Agus-Pulangi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Dito po nanggagaling kalahati po ng supply sa Mindanao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Even na Luzon, pero ang Bisayas, ang Mindanao ay bihira po because of Agus-Pulangi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Does Mindanao Development Authority agree that preserving affordable and reliable access to this renewable energy resource is essential to Mindanao development?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: If electricity is vital to Mindanao's development and Agus-Pulangi is a major government-owned source of electricity,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: what precisely is Mindanao's position on private participation in its rehabilitation operation and management arrangement?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Ano po ang operation and management?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Ano po ang arrangement po natin dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Distinguished colleague, iba ang ahensya na mag-iimplement ng privatization. Yung PSALM ang siyang mag-iimplement ng privatization [unclear].

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, Mr. Speaker, medyo gusto ko lang linawin ito. Are we going to privatize ang Agus-Pulangi o yung kanilang rehabilitation lang?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Okay. So, malinaw po, Mr. Speaker, on record, the Agus-Pulangi will not be privatized but only yung rehabilitation ang ibibigay sa private. Tama ba ako doon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Section 47F of EPIRA excluded Agus-Pulangi from the generation assets initially privatized, provided that the ownership will be transferred to PSALM and the hydropower complexes will continue to be operated

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: by NPC. It further states that privatization is left to PSALM's discretion in consultation with Congress.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: We have to kasi. Nasa EPIRA law too. Section 47F, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished sponsor, meron po bang naganap na konsultasyon sa Kongreso?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Kung tungkol sa rehabilitation ng Agus-Pulangi, as far as I know, wala po akong alam na [unclear] hindi po ito kasama sa mandato ng Mindanao [unclear].

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Ang gusto ko lang po dito malaman ay kung ano po talaga ang position ng Minda sa pangangalagaan natin sa nag-iisa na lamang na government-owned.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Ito na lang po ang natitira. Kasi lahat po ng generation naibenta na ng PSALM. Ito na lang po ang kaisa-isa, ang Agus-Pulangi sa Mindanao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: As the Development Authority in Mindanao, would you allow the vital and strategic energy asset na mapunta na lamang sa kamay ng private corporation?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Again, you said you are not willing to turn it over or to sell it to private corporation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, tama po yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: That would be my five times na I asked you and you said yes, na hindi ibebenta. Thank you for that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: May ginawa po ba ang MinDA para makasiguro na ang mga tao sa Agus, sa Lanao, sa Bukidnon

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: sa Iligan o sa iba pang mga apektadong komunidad na kasama sila sa decision-making patungkol dito sa Agus-Pulangi?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Sigurado po ako ay importante po itong issue na ito para sa ating mga local communities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Have you ever engaged the people from Lanao, Bukidno, even in Iligan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Pagdating po rito, nagkaroon ba ng public consultation? Even yung rehabilitation lang?

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Considering that Minda is a member of the Power Monitoring Committee, nagkaroon po ng consultation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, every year, nagkakaroon ng...

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Mindanao Power Summit, kasama ang lahat ng stakeholders sa summit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So every year, there's a consultation. Was the consultation included or it being mentioned, the privatization or even the rehabilitation of Agus-Pulangi? Kasama po ba yan

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: At tuloy-tuloy ang pag-uusap tungkol sa Agus-Pulangi, kasama ang Department of Energy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: When you say continuous dialogue, ano ho yung pinag-uusapan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: In privatization ho ba o hindi?

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Only privatization of maintenance and rehabilitation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So ano ho ang sabi ng mga tao from Bukidnon, Iligan, and Lanao? Are they in favor of privatization of Agus-Pulangi?

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleague, ang gusto ng taong bayan ay rehabilitation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Rehabilitation, but not privatization of Agus-Pulangi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, for that. At least natutuwa ako, lalo na si Kong Serge Dagooc na nanonood ngayon sa atin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Dahil nandun siya sa Mindanao ngayon. Umiiyak siguro habang pinanonood tayo na sa Agus-Pulangi yung tao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: He's a very dedicated person, being a lineman himself.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Given Mindanao Development Authority mandate to promote, coordinate, and facilitate Mindanao's socioeconomic development,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: is the agency truly protecting the interests of Mindanao when it supports or tolerates an arrangement that may place a major government-owned source of electricity under private control?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: I guess, nasagot mo naman na ito, so we don't have to answer that. At least a sign of relief.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Did MinDA ever submit a written recommendation to the President, DOE, PSALM, NPC, even Congress, or any other responsible body concerning Agus-Pulangi?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Does that recommendation prioritize the long-term welfare of Mindanao residents?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Over short-term fiscal proceeds or private investor returns?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Again, Mr. Speaker, before Congress approves its proposed fiscal year 2027 budget, Mindanao Development Authority should assure this August body that it is genuinely prioritizing the welfare of the people of Mindanao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And is committed to the inclusive and sustainable development of the region.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: That commitment must be demonstrated not only through plans, meetings, and policy statements, but through the protection of Mindanao's strategic public assets, particularly Agus-Pulangi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: These facilities are essential to Mindanao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: They must remain subject to public accountability and must not be placed under the control of private entities at the expense of consumers, electric, cooperatives, host communities, and the broader public interest.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Accordingly, the Mindanao Development Authority should clearly and unequivocally state that it will not support

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: any arrangement that transfers effective control of Agus-Pulangi to private corporations without transparent justification, congressional consultation, strong consumer safeguards, and continuing public control.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Mindanao should also assure this committee that it is not siding with private corporations for their own commercial or financial interests.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: The recommendation must be based solely on its statutory mandate and the long-term welfare of the people of Mindanao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Minda should have a clear commitment to remain independent, transparent, accountable, and firmly aligned with the people of Mindanao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Before I end my interpellation, Mr. Speaker, Congressman Dagooc and I strongly oppose the privatization of Agus-Pulangi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Yan na lang po ang nag-iisang generation po ng ating gobyerno.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Sana manatili pong yan government-owned para po sa ating mga kababayan sa Mindanao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Again, thank you very much, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And of course, to the good-looking sponsor and to the rest of Mindanao Development Authority family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: With that, Mr. Speaker, there being no more members of the minority who wishes to interpolate,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: I move to terminate the sponsorship and debate for the budget of Mindanao Development Authority.

segments.text: So tuloy-tuloy po ang pagresolba ng mga kailangan ng mga claim [unclear].

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Yes, distinguished sponsor, or no? Naintindihan ko po ito. So under the Marawi Siege Victims Compensation Act, na lamang po few years left. Gaya ng nasabi ko kanina, nasagot niyo rin na hanggang 2028 na lang to fulfill the mandate of the Marawi Siege Victims Compensation Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ngayon, dahil sa napakaliit ng inyong pondo kada taon at medyo malaki pa ang kailangan para ma-complete ito, ano po ba yung concrete timeline or milestone ng MCB to ensure na yung full disbursement po natin sa ating mga beneficiaries [unclear] sunset provision takes effect?

segments.text: Actually, it depends on the available budget, and MCB will ensure that it will continue its adjudication function despite [unclear].

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ibig sabihin po ba nito, Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, sakaling hindi po nabigay yung full amount of budget natin hanggang 2028, ibig sabihin wala na pong continuation ng plan na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Hindi na po talaga makukompensate yung mga beneficiaries na hindi napagbigyan dahil po lang sa pondo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: After the last lifespan of this MCB, it will be turned over to DHSUD for the [unclear] implementation of giving compensation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Yes po. Mr. Sponsor, yung opisina ko po, we've received reports from CSOs that confusion has arisen among claimants.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Dahil sa paglipat ng thousands of property damage claims sa NHA, maaari bang ipaliwanag ang dahilan ng transfer na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Actually, there's a moa between MCB and NHA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: In transferring the claim under Section 5 of Republic Act 11696 to the National Housing Authority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Paano po kaya natin masisiguro na ang MCB, hindi na ito magdudulot ng dagdag na stress at further trauma?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Sa ating mga biktima ng Marawi siege, lalo pat, ito transfer na natin sa NHA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Kasi po, may nareceive po kaming informations na kung sakali ma-transfer na ito sa NHA, dagdag stress daw po ito sa kanila dahil magre-reset na naman daw po sila ng kanilang mga requirements.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Hindi naman, Mr. Speaker, hindi naman matitigil yung, hindi sila, hindi magbabak to zero ang MCB.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Kumbaga, kung ano yung natapos, itutuloy lamang ng NHA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Finally, distinguished sponsor, anong mekanism ang pinapairal ng MCB

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: para ang compensation process ay hindi lamang mabilis kundi transparent at free from bureaucratic delays or inconsistencies?

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, as a quasi-judicial body, we have to ensure na tama at eligible ang mga babayaran.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: But from time to time, we regularly review and streamline the process. The process generally involves filing, technical and legal evaluation, clarification hearing when necessary, deliberation and decision by the Board, posting, publication, and awarding and payment. For structural claims there must first be technical assessment,

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: which may involve validation and ocular inspection. Claims then undergo legal evaluation before being raffled to a division for adjudication. We have streamlined the process by allowing claims below 10 million to be decided at the division level instead of requiring every claim to undergo en banc deliberation, thereby removing a significant [unclear].

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Aside from regular reporting and monitoring of accomplishment, mentioned earlier including assessment of quota rates, available din po ang mga reporting data through the website.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor, nine years ago na po ang Marawi siege.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Nakakabahala na hanggang ngayon hindi pa rin makuha ng ating mga kapatid sa Marawi ang hustisya para sa kanilang mga pamilya, mga mahal sa buhay at bahay at kabuhayang nawala.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Hindi tayo po papayag na mambigo natin sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Sana po, Madam Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor, makita naman po natin ang prioridad dito sa pag-compensate po natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Sa mga naging biktima po ng Marawi siege.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Kung sa, kung 1 billion pesos po ang kanilang pondo right now na sinasabi po ng MCB na ito ay kulang at ang kailangan nila hanggang sa matapos itong lahat ay nasa 7.6 billion, eh mukhang hindi po ata natin ito tinutupad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: At hindi po tayo nagiging compliant sa naging batas po natin, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor, madagdagan naman po natin itong budget po ng MCB. Maraming salamat po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Daphne A. Lagon
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I move that we recognize Representative...

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: The Honorable Rene Luis Co is recognized for her interpellation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Speaker, and good evening for Distinguished Sponsor and the Marawi Compensation Board.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Gusto ko lang pong mag-take off doon sa questioning ng ating colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Kung saan, binring up niya po at magpapa-explain sa...

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ito po ay nasa news reports, and mismo ang Marawi Compensation Board po ang nagpahayag na yung mga kaso for compensation were transferred to the jurisdiction of the NHA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Pwede po bang malaman yung basis, legal basis, for this transfer?

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Ang Madam Speaker, Distinguished Colleague, ang basis po ay yung Section 4 and Section 5 of Republic Act 11690.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Na doon po nagsasabi, may nakalagay po doon na ang NHA po ang maghahawak or ipapahawak or pwedeng ipahawak sa ibang ahensya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ipapag natapos na po or nag-proceed na sa sunset clause ng Marawi Compensation Board.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Under the sunset clause, yun ang D-SUD ang mag-implement ng pangsyon ng Marawi Compensation Board.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Maari po bang makahingi po ng kopya ang representasyong ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Sa mga memorandums of agreement between the NCM and the NHA regarding that transfer, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: We will give you a copy of the memorandum of agreement, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ito po ang NCM and NHA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Considering that there is clear basis, Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor, in Section 5,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: RA 11696 as to the compensation under the right of way,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: would MCB know if there was a line item under the NHA to fund compensation for these transferred cases?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Alam naman po natin na dahil po sa siege, marami pong mga daanan ang nasira at kung ano pong kailangang repairs na kailangang gawin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Is the MCB aware na may line item?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: O ba ang NHA to fund compensation for these transferred cases?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: For the year 2027, Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor, wala pong...

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Considering the following, Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: we will make a manifestation that the Committee on Appropriations make the needed amendment to the budget of NHA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: To ensure that these amounts are funded.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: under the GAA. Sayang naman po kung may ganito ngang MOA o kung hindi man po for implementation ngayon ay magkakaroon po ang NHA ng role for compensation of these transferred cases pero hindi naman po mababadyetan. Madam Speaker, good sponsor, let that show on the record.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang susunod ko pong tanong Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor, malapit po sa puso ng kinatawan na ito ay kung kamusta po ang pag-aaral ng mga apektadong kabataang maranaw tungkol po sa state ng schooling, infrastructure, and yung pagtutuloy-tuloy nilang pag-aaral.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor, does the MCV have a list of schools that were affected by the siege?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ito po, sila po ba ay naayos na? Kung hindi pa kumpleto ang pagsasayayos sa kanilang lahat, ano po ang status sa ngayon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Your Honor, ang status po, meron na pong 10 four-story school buildings with a capacity of 9,000 to 10,000 students.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: By next month, according to the NHA,

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: na meron nang malilipatan next month, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor, tama po ba narinig ko: ten buildings?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ten four-story buildings na kaya pong mag-house in ng 9,000 to 10,000 students.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: At sa ngayon ay hindi pa po ito bukas, ongoing ang construction. Next month ay bubuksan na. Tama po ba, Madam Speaker, good sponsor?

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Tama po yan, Madam Speaker, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor, prior po to next month or as of now, saan po nag-aaral ang mga kabataan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Binigay ng LGU, Madam Speaker, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor, maghihingi na lang po, kung maaari, ang kinatawan na ito ng listahan ng mga paaralan na ayos na, aayusin pa, ano pong kailangang status para po ma-check kung maayos po bang naitatawid ang access to education ng mga kabataan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Posible po ba yan, Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang huling nating line of questioning ay tungkol po sa na-bring up na rin po ay restitution.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor, isang dekada na halos pagkatapos ng 2017 siege, full restitution remains an unfulfilled promise for thousands of Maranaos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: While the Marawi Compensation Board was authorized under RA 11696 to compensate victims,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: meron nga po tayong natanggap na report na 3,100 housing-related claims are being offloaded to NHA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Habang thousands of internally displaced persons or IDPs remain stranded in temporary shelters nearly a decade later.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Meron tayong mga paunang explanation ng mga kahirapan sa mga...

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: listahan, sa records, na sa atin, no, kailangan pong masikap na maigpawan para po mabilis na mabigay na sa mga IDPs at hanggang ngayon ay hindi pa rin nakakamit ng justisya dahil po sa nangyari.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang tatanong ko na lang po, ano po bang measures in place ang nariyan po ngayon sa Marawi Compensation Board to prevent,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: files from getting lost in bureaucratic transitions? Meron po tayong paglilipat ng records na ibibigay sa NHA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Paano natin may ensure na yung listahan na po ito, kumpleto, ito po ay na-check na, kumbaga, at hindi po mawawala?

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Madam Speaker, mayroon pong signed terms of reference ang MCB at saka ang NHA

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: para sigurado na maayos yung transition of files ng MCB to NHA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So nagbibigay po ng paninigurado at commitment ang MCV na ang transition ng mga documents ay magiging maayos,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: hindi po sana mawawala yung mga listahan at kung may validation na kailangan gawin ay gagawin po, Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor, ang huli na lang nating tanong ay nakita naman natin na nakakaantig ng puso na a small fraction of the targeted permanent housing units

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ang natuturn over pa lamang sa displaced residents.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Meron po bang concrete steps na ginagawa to accelerate turnover?

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Actually, wala na sa MCV yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: NHA na ang mag-continue ng lahat ng dapat ayusin para tuloy-tuloy na mabigyan ng mga...

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Pero tama po ba, Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor, wala pa sa NHA sa ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, nasa kapangyarihan pa rin po ng MCV sa ngayon na tumaha ng concrete steps to accelerate unit turnover.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, baka po pwedeng makapagdetali ano po yung pwedeng magawa para po mas mapabilis pa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Lalo na't ayaw din naman nating paabutin sa sunset clause.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, bago po, may marami pa rin naghihintay dito sa turnover.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Ang NHA ang sa settlement at ang MCB ay sa compensation lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Marami pa rin pong may concerns sa Marawi Compensation Board.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Magiging bukas po ba ang MCV sa isang dialogo sa mga internally displaced persons,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: sa lahat ng mga apektadong sektor para po mas mapabilis yung hindi lang turnover ng unit,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: pero ma-streamline yung concerns at maayos na matawid yung kanilang mga hinahing para po maaksyonan ng MCV?

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Makipag-dialog para sa lahat ng kailangan gawin sa mga claimants, Your Honor, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Maraming salamat po. Let the record reflect ang pagbukas sa dialogo na gusto po natin sa susunod at sa malapit na panahon ay mangyari

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: para po yung ating mga naging issue na ina-identify ay mabilis po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: At sana po yung NHA, sila din po ay appraised nun sa mga steps na tinitake natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor, that is all. Thank you very much.

segments.text: Madam Speaker, may recognize Representative Sara Elago for her interpellation.

segments.text: Nais ko na lamang pong maituloy yung pagtatanong ng ating mga kasamahan tungkol sa...

segments.text: Ayon ho sa ulat ng MCB, as of August 31, 2026, mayroon itong 4.362 billion total appropriations,

segments.text: kung saan 2.362 billion ang released allotments.

segments.text: Nakasaad din na mayroon pang 2 billion pesos na unallocated amount pending further release from DBM.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ano ang dahilan kung bakit hindi pa nailalabas ang natitirapan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: Actually, hindi pa na-re-release yung 2 billion from DBM, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Nicanor M. Briones
segments.text: And I have the review pa ng DBM, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dahil sinabi din ng MCB na pagkatapos ng 2026 ay wala na silang matitira na pondo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Lalong-lalo na para sa 2027 ay napakaliit lamang ng kanilang pondo na naisama sa General Appropriations Bill

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon, ang MCB po ay nailikha sa ilalim ng Republic Act No. 11696 at nagsimula.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nakatakdang matapos ang five-year mandate nito sa June 3, 2028.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: As of August 2026, may halos dalawang taon na lamang ang board.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa kasalukuyang mga backlog at funding requirements na narinig po natin sa ating deliberasyon ngayong gabi,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
