segments.text: With that, Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor, ang susunod po na katanungan ko, follow up lamang po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Saan po, nakasaad na may kapangyarihan ang BCDA na i-penalize ang mga non-compliant companies, kung meron man po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Again, Madam Speaker, wala pa pong agreement. Pero again, sinusigurado po ng BCDA na magiging compliant po tayo sa mga batas ng Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Sana po, kung ano yung napag-usapan natin dito, uulitin ko po, kung sinasabi ninyo ganyan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: maganda po yung balita. Pero hanggat wala pong agreement, wala pong provision, wala pong papel, nakakabahala pa rin po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Susunod po na katanungan ko ay, paano naman po isisiguro ng BCDA na malayang makapag-unionize ang mga manggagawa sa loob ng mga development projects na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Again, Madam Speaker, we will follow Philippine labor laws.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: At ito naman po ay nakasaad sa provision po natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Kaugnay po nung nangyari sa DHL, sana hindi po mangyari yung nangyari sa DHL na Philippine labor law ang sinunod,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: pero nung nagka-unionize, biglang umayaw na si DHL. So sana hindi po gano'n yung mangyayari dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Paano naman po isisiguro ng BCDA na ang mga manggagawang Pilipino,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: ang majority na mahahire sa mga high quality jobs sa Clark Advanced Manufacturing Park?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Baka naman po kasi dahil foreign country yung papasok dito,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: baka naman po dadalhin din nila yung kanilang mga manggagawa mula sa ibang bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Ayon po sa ating BOI, ang nakasaad po ay minimum 90% po ang mga Pilipino na magtatrabaho.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: As a-handing po natin yan na makikita natin sa provision or sa agreement po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: At hindi ko na itatanong kung saan parte po yun ng agreement ng Paxilica dahil kagaya ng nasagot nyo po kanina,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: wala pa nga po. So sana nga, nandoon din po yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: As you can see, dear colleague, in the past months, Paxilica is toted as the economic miracle of the country.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Pero wala pa palang malinaw na agreement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: It's extremely concerning na nag-hard launch na ang BCDA, nag-notify na sa LGU at sa mga residenteng maapektuhan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Pero ang sagot, lagi ay wala pa palang malinaw na kongkretong agreement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Nagpadala na rin kayo ng notices sa mga residente, pero wala pa rin po palang agreement, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Are we being taken for a ride with this agreement?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Madam Speaker, as we said, wala pa pong final na mga pag-uusap.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Meron pa lang pong mga diskusyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Meron pa lang pong initial discussions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Kaya po, siguro kapag meron na pong feedback.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: doon po natin maisasalaysay at mayuulat kung ano po yung magiging final agreements po natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Naintindihan ko po ito Madam Speaker, Madam Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Medyo nabahala lang ako doon sa nakapag-notify na wala pa palang agreement,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: nasa usapan pa lang pala tayo kung ano-anong mga provisions ang gagawin natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Hindi po yata tama na inonotify na natin ang mga residente para sila ay makaalis na tapos wala pa palang agreement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ang 2027 budget ng BCDA, ang year zero bago magsimula ang construction.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Yet mukhang wala pa palang kapangyarihan ang lead agency para dito para masigurong

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: ang mga Pilipino talaga ang magbe-benefit at hindi mga dayuhan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Dadako naman po ako sa usapin at concerns ng indigenous people at mga community na maa-apektuhan ng development ng Paxilica.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Madam Sponsor, para po sa inyong kaalaman at sa BCDA family, ako po ay isang indigenous people, isa po akong IP,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: kaya mahalaga po sa akin yung karapatan ng aking mga constituent na mga IP, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: There are indigenous peoples and indigenous cultural communities that will be affected if the project pushes through.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Madam Speaker, siguro para magbigay po ng mas malawak na perspektibo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: yung pong Clark Freeport Special Economic Zone ay meron pong 35,300 hectares.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: At ito pong camp na tinutukoy natin ay 1,620 hectares lamang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Doon po sa kabuan ng 35,300, inalis na po doon, binukod na po yung ating pong mga ancestral domain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Meron pong halos 15,000 na nakabukod na po na ginagalang ng BCDA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Pero dito po sa ating campsite, wala pa po, even at the NCIP level, wala pong CAD-T or CALT na nare-recognize pa po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Salamat po, no? Magandang balita kung sakaling ganun nga talaga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Dahil ibig sabihin, pinapahalagahan po natin ang mga indigenous people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Gayun pa man po, gusto ko lang i-follow up na naintindihan ko na sinegregate na po natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: gagal na po natin yung mga may ancestral domain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ngayon, ang tanong ko po, may mga communities pa rin po ba na maapektuhan na sila ay mga indigenous people,

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Madam Speaker, doon po sa New Clark City Special Economic Zone, Freeport and Special Economic Zone,

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: meron pong ilang both IP and non-IP na settlers po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: So, ibig sabihin may maaapektuhan ng mga IP community na walang ancestral domain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Doon po sa area, nakasama sa 35,300 hectares.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Doon po sa camp area, doon sa 1,600 hectares po, meron po na ilang mga IP and non-IP families.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ano po kaya ang magiging commitment ng BCDA na itong mga IP na to,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: despite not having an ancestral domain,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: ma-re-respeto pa rin ang kanilang rights as an indigenous people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Can the BCDA commit na meron pa rin po tayong i-implace or i-impose na batas para sa ating mga IP constituents

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: na even if wala po silang ancestral domain?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Madam Speaker, para po doon sa affected families, IP families po natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: BCDA will coordinate with NCIP and the LGU para po matukoy ang kanila pong saloobin

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: at siyempre tignan po kung ano po yung pwedeng mabigay natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: May tulong ng ating pong gobyerno sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Hindi po natin sila, hindi isasama sa ating pong developmental and social plan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Definitely po, hindi po natin hahayaan na wala po tayong ibibigay na alternatibong option para po sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: ang lead government agency na magli-lead dito sa Paxilica project na ito,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: sana po ay kayo po mismo yung bababa sa grounds at kakausap sa mga IP constituents or even non-IP constituents.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Huwag po sana nating hayaan na ang sulat lang, written document lang,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: ang mag-i-inform sa kanila ng ano na pong,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: kung nangyayari doon po sa area of responsibility din po ng proyektong ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: So, inaasahan ko po, sana po ay makita po natin itong improvement at saka progress po dito sa pagkakausap po sa ating mga IP constituents.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: With that, Madam Speaker, distinguished sponsor, for closing, in closing,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: pasensya na po pero medyo hindi ko po kasi naiintindihan kung bakit,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: minamadali din po natin yung Paxilica at ang mga planong Advanced Manufacturing Park

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: ng marami pang hindi nasasagot ng mga concerns.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Sana po, unahin po natin muna yung mga concerns bago po natin madaliin ang mga agreements na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Malinaw naman sa ating mga Pinoy na kung hindi nakataga sa bato,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: ang mga pangako ay posibleng napapakataon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: So, yun lamang po ang gusto naming makita.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Sana ito ay nakadokumento, may papeles, may agreement, may probisyon na magsesecure

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: na hindi po masisira ang ating kalikasan, ang ating bansa, at ang ating komunidad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Baka mauwi lang sa pambubudol ang mga pangakong high quality jobs, mga pangakong world class technology,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: transfer kung wala naman pala tayo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Kaya yung nakikita pa sa agreement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: But anyway, Madam Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor, maraming salamat po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Daphne A. Lagon
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I move to recognize Representative Ko for her interpellation.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: The Honorable Ko is hereby recognized. Please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Magandang gabi sa ating Distinguished Sponsor ngayong gabi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Maari po bang sumagot ng ilang tanong tungkol sa...

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: sa budget at mga pulisiya na gusto pong ipatupad ng BCDA?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Madam Speaker. Good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang una po nating tanong ay ang announcement din,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: hindi lang ng BCDA pero iba-iba rin pong ahensya ng gobyerno

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ng April 16, 2026, pumirma ang Pilipinas sa Pax Silica Declaration.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Can I get a confirmation if that's true, Madam Speaker? Good sponsor?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Pumirma po ang Pilipinas sa isang non-binding statement of shared principles.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Sa website ng Board of Investments na nakuha natin ang access dito dahil dinirect po tayo

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ng Board of Investments mismo sa DTI.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: budget briefing. Meron po ditong sulat, liham galing sa BCDA

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: na ?Proposal for a Pax Silica Coordination Office in Clark,? dated April 9, 2026. May I get a confirmation kung ito po ay pinadala ng BCDA?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor, meron po tayong mga katanungan

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: tungkol po sa liham na ito

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: At ang mga nagsunod-sunod ng developments na nag-arise from the signing of this statement and subsequent plans, proposals, declarations ng iba't-ibang ahensya ng gobyerno.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ayon po dito sa April 9, 2026 letter ng BCDA, binubukas niya po ang 4,000 hectares acres strategically located in the Luzon Economic Corridor under a lease-free agreement may grace period of two years bilang offer of in-kind contribution towards developing and advancing the bilateral economic security partnership between the governments of the Philippines

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: and the United States of America. May scope and objectives, meron pong paglatag ng terms at ng legal basis. Ang tanong ko po, if the offer of land proceeded or was simultaneous with the country's formal partnership, ano pong otoridad o propriety na meron ng BCDA to commit up to 4,000 acres of sovereign state land to a foreign coalition,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: the Philippines had not yet formally joined. Madam Speaker, good sponsor, maaari po ba tayong ma-enlighten dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Madam Speaker, katulad po ng nabanggit ng ating distinguished colleague, ito po ay isang proposal na pinadala po ng BCDA. Hindi po ito na iba sa mga proposal na pinapadala ng BCDA bilang isang IPA or Investment Promotions Agency. Ito po kasi talaga yung mandato nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor, ano pong basihan kung bakit nagbukas ng proposal ang BCDA ng April 9, 2026 via letter sa Estados Unidos?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Ang basihan po ng proposal na pinadala ng BCDA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: ay yung mismong Republic Act na nag-create sa BCDA plus po yung isa pa po nating batas na Investor's Lease Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Mayroon po bang mga relevant agencies o kaya po ang presidente na nag-authorize ng offer na ito in advance?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Was anyone outside the BCDA involved in crafting this offer and authorizing this offer?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Ito pong proposal ay bunga ng ating pong pagsapi sa deklarasyon at dahil ito po ay pinadala sa ibang bansa, ito po ay nireview ng iba't ibang mga national agencies cleared para ipadala ng BCDA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, to clarify, ano pong deklarasyon na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Pero ang tanong Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor, prior to the sending of this letter ng April 9, ang presidente po ba o kahit anong relevant na ahensya ng gobyerno nag-authorize in advance of this offer?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So prior to April 9, Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Yes, Madam Speaker, kinlear po ito ng DOJ at in-endorse po ng DTI, ng DFA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So may clearance, endorsement ng DOJ and DFA prior to April 9, prior to sending the proposal?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Kailan po ito ginawa ng DOJ and DFA? Kailan po na-receive ng BCDA itong clearances and endorsements?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: The day before April 9, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Bakit po, curiosity, ang DOJ kailangang i-clear at i-endorse itong offer na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: To ensure po na ito po ay compliant sa ating pong BCDA Act at sa Investors Lease Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: And Philippine laws po, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor, is the DepDev ever consulted about the offer prior to the BCDA making it?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Hindi po, Madam Speaker, kasi ito po ay isang preliminary proposal pa lang po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Other than the DOJ and DFA, Madam Speaker, good sponsor, sino pa po ba involved dito sa pagbuo ng terms, ng scope ng proposal na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Aside from DOJ, DFA, BCDA po, and BOI.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor, kung maari din po natin makuha yun in a report na paglalatag ng sino pong mga ahensya, sino pong mga heads of agencies ang involved sa pagbuo ng proposal because I assume this high level of proposal, kahit sabihin mang preliminary,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: marami pong recurso ang pinag-uusapan, ang tinataya, at hindi naman po basta-basta lang na mga ahensya na hindi na konsulta sa appropriate other government bodies na magagawa ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Kung maari din po ang mga dates at inputs at mga endorsements na ginawa na relevant ng mga DOJ, ng mga ahensya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Yes, Madam Speaker, we will comply.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So Madam Speaker, good sponsor, ang sunod nating tanong: ang Department of Agriculture o ang Department of Agrarian Reform ba nakonsulta ng BCDA bago po binuksan sa isang offer ang lupain na in-identify for Pax Silica, given that the site displaces active farmland in Tarlac?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Madam Speaker, ito pong pinag-uusapan po natin, public land under Clark Freeport and special economic zone, ito po ay naka-master plan na bilang isang economic zone po for industrial development.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So Madam Speaker, good sponsor, is the sponsor denying agricultural displacement?

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Madam Speaker, hindi po classified as agricultural land itong pinag-uusapan po nating subject area.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor, may sinasayit na essentially legal tag sa lupain na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang reality, however, ay around May this year, residents of Barangay Santa Lucia, Capas, says that PCDA sent a one-month eviction notice.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And several farmers also claimed PCDA had offered to purchase their land for only 30 pesos per square meter.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And in August, around 92 farmers in Barangay O'Donnell, Capas, Tarlac have reportedly been urged by the PCDA to vacate the farmland they have been cultivating.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Residents of Sitio Sapangkawayan, Barangay Aranguren, said the project could displace families from ancestral land where generations have lived and farmed while also putting their burial grounds, livelihood, and community institutions at risk.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: May mga senators po calling for a Senate probe amid complaints that farmers are allegedly being ordered to stop planting and are facing intimidation, arguing any land use conversion must follow due process under DAR rules.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Marami po tayong data, gaya na rin po sa preliminary, and preliminary pa lang po ito, na studies ng mga ibang ahensya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: The DA noted that 15,200 farmers might lose their agricultural land.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And a civil society organization, Calicasan, said the project could result in the long-term displacement of around 20,000 AITA residents.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: May sinasabi po na hindi po ito tagged as agricultural land.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: But is the BCDA aware of this when it made the proposal na may 20,000 AITA residents na nariyan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Meron pong 15,200 farmers na maaari pong mawala ang kanilang lupain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ito po yung paraan kung paano niya pinapatigil ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Reports of harassment, intimidation, para makuha, maklear yung lupain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Siguro parang meron pong discrepancy sa mga bilang na, malalaking mga bilang na naisalaysay po ninyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: We would like to request for a copy of this para ma-review po ng BCDA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Pero sa ngayon po, wala pong 20,000 farmers displaced and wala rin pong 20,000 AITAS displaced.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: In fact, again, ito pong pinag-uusapan po nating lupa ay special economic zone, hindi po siya agricultural.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: And yung kabuan po ng 35,300 hectares, nakabukod po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Ito po yung mga lupain na under ng DAR area.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Angela S. Garcia
segments.text: Ito po ay merong kabuang 10,700 hectares under DAR farmlands.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: To clarify, ang binigay ng mga numero ng kinatawan na ito ay mga estimates kung tuloy-tuloy na mangyari yung mga displacement na ongoing na po ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: We have heard preliminarily some defenses of SBMA,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: and this is also what is provided in an RTC ruling,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: the activities of such trade in SBMA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: But Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor, my question is,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: does being a separate customs territory as provided in law enable SBMA to circumvent,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: or essentially not follow, ratified international treaties and agreements?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Madam Speaker, the SBMA confirms the importation of scrapped mixed metals, computer accessories, used meter, used electronics, and scrapped copper.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: However, these importations, as per the SBMA, adhere to international treaties.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor, ano pong reaction ng SBMA na...

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: na under the Convention, and even under the implementing DNR Department Order,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: wala naman pong pagbubukod ng e-waste, na ito po ay separate or hindi considered as hazardous wastes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Hazardous wastes po siya na nililimitahan yung import-export regulation trade po nito ng Basel Convention,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: which explicitly provides, hindi po pwedeng magkaroon ng export from a non-party to a state party.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: SBMA still confirms that all importations of scrapped mixed metals are not hazardous.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: These all adhere to all environmental regulations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor, the Basel Action Network, which maintains and checks the compliance of states with the Basel Convention,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: found in its field investigations in both the U.S. and the Philippines, that these containers that arrived at the Subic Port from the United States,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: both contain hazardous electronic waste, classified as...

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: A-1181, and e-waste, requiring special consideration or Code 949.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: These are Basel waste listings, illegal to be imported into the Philippines from the U.S.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: due to the fact, again, that the U.S. is a non-party to the Convention.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor, what is the explanation behind the assertion that there is following of international treaty,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: the citation of this representation right now?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: the SBMA is willing to cooperate and to also submit to our Distinguished Colleague,

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: supporting documents that say that these materials are not hazardous,

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: just to establish that it also complies with all environmental compliances,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, we will welcome these submissions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: But I'd like an explanation on the floor right now.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ano po yung basihan kung bakit nasasabi, kahit succinctly po, Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: bakit po hindi iligal yung kalakala na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ano ang basihan kung bakit hindi po iligal ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: We have heard the RTC ruling, which says nga po na separate customs territory ang SBMA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: that doesn't mean that they are exempted from the Basel Convention,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: the DNR Department Order implementing it,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: and even other prevailing international laws and domestic regulations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, Madam Speaker, we will look forward to that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: But ano po on the floor, succinctly, ang rason?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Yes, Madam Speaker, just for the record also,

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: it's because the materials are not hazardous waste.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: These importations are scrap mixed metals, computer accessories,

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: used meters, used electronics, and scrap copper, which are not hazardous.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: So, SBMA reiterates that these are not hazardous waste.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: And so, the importation of such materials are not violated,

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: or doesn't violate international treaties and the Basel Convention as well.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Under what legal basis can the SBMA provide now to say that they are not hazardous waste?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Is this a different citation which they can state where it is classified differently

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: because the prevailing rules as of now lists the containers as hazardous electronic wastes and e-waste,

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Madam Speaker, as for the SBMA, these materials are all inspected from importation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Inspected by whom, Madam Speaker? Good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: The Bureau of Customs and DNR involved in the inspections, Madam Speaker. Good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: For now, there is no legal basis that has been cited other than the assurance that SBMA inspected them.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, Madam Speaker, good sponsor, given the limited time that I have,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: let it be stated on the record that to the question and to the...

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: legal basis that this representation cited, there has been no counter-legal basis provided.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor, my next line of question would be regarding the position of SBMA

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: in relation to a Committee on Ecology meeting I had the opportunity to attend on March 11, 2026,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: where our topic is hazardous waste management and strengthening the Environmental Management Bureau.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: We talked about the possible amendment of the Toxic and Hazardous Wastes Act present and prevailing in our jurisprudence now.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: SBMA was in attendance and it gave the position that they are pushing for the designation of free trade zones such as SUBIC

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: to become Basel Convention Free Zones.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor, ano pong ibig sabihin ng SBMA nung sinabi niya na gustong maging Basel Convention Free Zone

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And is the agency asking for an exception from international treaties and our local environmental laws?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Madam Speaker, distinguished colleague, the reason cited by the SBMA is some locators would want to

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: expand their operations to include imports from the United States, and because the United States is not a signatory of the Basel Convention, that is the basis for the statement of the SBMA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor, I think desiring trade with the United States is not a heavy enough justification to look for an exception from a prevailing international treaty that seeks to protect the Philippines from the transboundary waste trade disproportionately affecting Southeast Asian countries, to the point that there has to be a call from Southeast Asian countries that [unclear] not the

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: dumping ground or trash can of developed countries. But at the end of the day, it will remove us from protections already in place, not just in discussion with the US but also with other countries that may seek to do trade.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor, we will ask instead for a written explanation for that comment given in the March 11, 2026 hearing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: My next question, Madam Speaker, good sponsor, magkano po ba ang kinikita ng SBMA mula sa kalakalan ng recyclable waste?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: How much, I assume, of course, may kita ang ating mga locators dyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: How much of it goes to SBMA, Madam Speaker, good sponsor?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: [unclear] If the distinguished colleague will be willing to allow our distinguished sponsor and the SBMA family to submit a written report.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Okay, for payments of recyclers, as per SBMA data, it's around 200, sorry, 205 million pesos, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor, in the interest of time, we will also be requesting the same to be submitted via a written report.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: As well as details on how much private recycling facilities yield in profit, alongside how much that would go to SBMA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: My next question would be in relation to its budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: SBMA's proposed 500 million subsidy is for ecozone infrastructure, but the NEP also records 1 billion in unreleased 2025 appropriations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Has that amount now been released, Madam Speaker? We'd like to seek a clarification.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Which brought, maybe that, Madam Speaker?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: It hasn't been released yet, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: It has not yet been released, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: We also just ask to submit by report which projects are affected because of its non-release yet

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: and what must be resolved before they can proceed, Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: As we will comply, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: My next question would be in relation to the joint efforts of the BOC, the DENREMB, and SBMA,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: We saw that in July 1 of this year, they publicly posted that they conducted a joint inspection

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: on several recycling locators in Subic.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Can this representation be furnished with a copy of this report, Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Yes, we will comply, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And Madam Speaker, Good Sponsor, if ma, masama po sana,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: di lang ng mga nag-ooperate ng mga recycling locators doon

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: because when we asked DENREMB yesterday, wala raw po silang data on the recycling facilities in Subic.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And so, the appropriate agency to ask would be the one...

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: We'll also give our distinguished colleague a copy, but there are, as of now, 14 active locators, 18 total.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: We will submit the list, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And my last line of questioning, Madam Speaker, this would be in relation to the public pronouncements of SBMA

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: We have seen that sa pinirmahan na MOU ng SBMA at BCDA, may pagbubukas na gagamitin ng Subic Bayport

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: bilang quote-unquote maritime gateway ng Paxilica.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Maari po bang malaman ang extent nito?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: I believe that was the last question of our distinguished colleague.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: And after the sponsor response, may we request our distinguished colleague from Kabataan Party List to wrap up.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Yes, Madam Speaker, it will be my last question.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: I just like to note that according to the press release, the port will serve DAO.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: It's a critical gateway enabling the efficient movement of raw materials into the country

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: and timely delivery of finished products to customers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So we'd like clarification sa extent nito, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: It's a MOU between BCDA and SBMA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: So it's just restricted to the use of Port of Subic, the limited use of Port of Subic for the maritime logistics requirements of the proposed project.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Okay, a copy of this MOU.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: A copy of this MOU would also be requested, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Thank you for your time and for the clarification.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rhea Mae A. Gullas
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I move that we recognize the Honorable Antonio Tino for his interpellation.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: The Honorable Antonio Tino is recognized.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ilang mga tanong po sa sponsor natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Well, I'll ask the sponsor to explain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ano po ba ang ambag ng SBMA sa ekonomiya ng Pilipinas?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Madam Speaker, briefly, as of now, there are 1,783 locators.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Ang ini-employ po ang may trabaho dahil sa SBMA ay 174,930 na tao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Ang total investment na nakuha na ng SBMA ay 610 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Tapos ang nabigay na sa Pambansang Pamalaan through dividends is 12.15.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Iyan po ba para sa isang taon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Mga foreign investor po ba ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Foreign and domestic po, mix po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Tama po ba? May mga information din tayo rito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And is it correct there are 15 operational piers and wharves?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kasi subik harbor yan, di ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, mainly port, it used to be.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: There are 15 operational piers and wharves?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ito, may mga info po tayong nakuha.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, parang container, yun yung standard measure ng container size, di ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Is that more or less correct?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ganon, yung shipping na dumadaan dyan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Yes, total capacity is 600,000, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At in terms of GDP, meron ba kayong figure sa ambag ng subik sa GDP, kumbaga, ng Pilipinas?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Meron lang po tayo for, ano, well, overall contribution to the national economy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: So, for 2020, isa sabi dito po yung collections from the Bureau of Customs, yung mga taxes po na binabayaran sa BIR, yung dividends po na babayaran sa national government, tapos sa LGU share.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Consistent po na over 50 billion since 2022, per year, na nabibigay po ng SBMA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Over 50 billion po ang naibibigay ng SBMA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Consistently, over 50 billion ang nabibigay ng subik ng SBMA. Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sa national government. So, safe to say, napakahalaga po nito, hindi lang sa regional economy ng Region 3, kundi national economy. Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At kanina, pinanong natin sa BCDA,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Gusto ko rin marinig sa inyo, nagkaroon po ng MOU sa pagitan ng BCDA at SBMA designating the port of subik as the primary entry and exit point for logistics, etc. under Paxilica. Correct?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. So, in other words, involved din po sa Paxilica ang subik. Tama po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Yes, Madam Speaker. As a port.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: As the port. Parang dito yung main na...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Entry and exit point. Dalu yan ng mga investment, produkto, and so on. Including, for example, energy. Parang ganun po yung narinig natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Madam Speaker, as per the MOU, binasignate lang po ang port of subik as yung gateway for the maritime logistics requirements.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Sige. Okay. Now, yung subik, hindi po yan EDCA site, hindi po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And necessarily, hindi siya EDCA site kasi yung mga approved locations under the EDCA agreement, they have to be properties provided by the AFP and DND, mga military locations. So, subik, hindi. Tama?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Nevertheless, tama rin po ba na malaganap ang gamit ng US military sa subik? Is that correct?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Naku, yung oras tumutuloy, Madam Speaker. So, i-consider nyo na lang yan.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: If our distinguished colleague is amenable, the SBMA family can actually furnish your office to our good sponsor, a written response to your queries.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. That would be great, Madam Speaker. But I think the sponsor is also ready to give a response.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Yes. The SBMA confirms that there are economic activities that involve American firms, American actors.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: American firms servicing the US military. Correct?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: For example, let me cite, ito based on mga open source research, diba? Subik Dry Dock Corporation. Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ginagawa nila, repair and overhaul of US Navy vessels. Correct?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. The PCSPC fuel terminal, yung pinakamalaking fuel depot sa buong bansa, in fact, that is owned by an American equity firm, I-squared Capital.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At, hindi po ba, among others, it stores fuel...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: It stores fuel for exclusive use of the US Navy. Tama po ba? Among others, hindi lahat. Hindi lahat. Pero merong fuel na ginagamit ng US Navy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Not exclusive. Pero meron. Tama po. Correct?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Alam ko, yung recently, yung PNOC, bumili ng diesel, tapos nilagay din dyan. Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Strategic Oil Reserve or Fuel Reserve ay nandyan, katabi nung fuel ng US Navy. Tama po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: February 2025, US Marine Corps Repositioning Warehouse. This is a 5,300 square meter facility used to store vehicle communications assets, engineering assets. Correct?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Correct. So yung US Marine Corps, meron silang storage facility dyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Army staging. Aguila, Subic. Processing and storage of US Army equipment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Tama po ba? Ito, yung Aguila facility sa Subic, ginagamit ng US Army naman ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Isa, Marine Corps. Ito naman, Army.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And the contractor for that is an American logistics contractor for the U.S. military known as V2X.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yun po, V2X. Alam po niyan ni Chairman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. V2X is a defense contractor for logistics ng U.S. military.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yun, part of Subic Bay, ginagamit routinely for maintenance ng mga U.S. Navy ships including submarines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Diba, yung mga Ohio-class nuclear submarines ng U.S. ay nandyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Dumadaong dyan, nagpapaayos, nagpaparefuel, and so on and so forth.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: The most recent incident being a U.S. destroyer that was recently stranded for four days in the South China Sea.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Tapos nawala ng kuryente. Tapos dinala sa Subic. Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, malinaw po, as I said, extensively used by the U.S. military ang Subic.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: In fact, mas ginagamit pa po ito ng U.S. military kesa sa mga EDCA locations, yung approved locations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: O hindi n?yo na, hindi n?yo na...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Hindi na sa inyo manggagaling. Ako na nagsasabi na ito talaga yung main...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Entry and exit point, storage point, logistics hub ng U.S. military dito sa Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Lalo na pagbalikatan. At saka yung ibang mga exercises. So, napakalinaw po nun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. At the same time, sinabi natin kanina, this is the main economic engine in Luzon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And in much of... and in the larger Filipino economy, correct?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Ngayon, ito po ang isang concern natin dito, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ano po ang nangyari sa Iran war, particularly sa Gulf State?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
